title_translated: 追踪LLM推理轨迹中迭代博弈的表征
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理通过思维链（CoT）推理在各领域实现了顶尖性能。尽管其应用广泛，但对其外部化推理轨迹与模型实际计算之间的关系仍知之甚少。我们通过研究LLM代理在不完全信息的迭代博弈中的决策过程来解决这一问题。利用一系列机制可解释性技术，我们发现模型在整个CoT过程中形成了并不断修正对博弈的内部表征。一旦模型过早地坚持错误信念，便很少能恢复。这种失败在文字轨迹和层激活中均有体现。随着多智能体系统日益普及，我们的工作为更精准诊断其战略推理错误打开了大门。为便于说明，我们在 https://interp-self.github.io/gametrace/ 提供了选定样本轨迹的方法交互可视化工具。

summary: Language models can gain capacity at little computational cost from n-gram embedding tables: large tables of learned vectors for short sequences of consecutive tokens, which are looked up and added to the model's input or to its intermediate layers. Recent designs commonly use a separate n-gram embedding table for each layer, which makes the tables costly in memory and prevents layers from sharing what they learn. Sharing a single table, however, gives every layer the same embedding and leaves no room for layer-wise preferences, and it performs poorly in practice. We propose Chorus, in which one set of n-gram embedding tables serves the whole network and every layer reads it in its own way. Each layer maps the refined embedding through its own projection layer, after rescaling its components by factors computed from its current hidden state. Chorus matches the quality of existing n-gram methods with 87% smaller tables: with 1.2B table parameters it predicts text better than FactorEngram and DeepSeek's Engram do with 9.6B. It outperforms Engram, TN-gram and FactorEngram in every setting where we compared them, across table sizes from 20M to 9.6B parameters. We also show that the recently proposed memory-efficient optimizer Ember works well with Chorus, saving 99.2% of table-optimizer memory compared with AdamW without degrading training performance. These results enable further scaling of n-gram embedding tables along the table-size axis by reducing memory use and allowing shared knowledge to be reused across layers.
title: Chorus: Shared N-gram Embeddings with Layer-wise Adaptation
title_translated: Chorus：基于层间自适应的共享n-gram嵌入
summary_translated: 语言模型可以通过n-gram嵌入表在几乎不增加计算成本的情况下提升容量：这些是针对连续词元短序列学习得到的向量大表，可被查表并添加到模型输入或中间层。近期设计通常为每一层使用独立的n-gram嵌入表，这导致内存开销大，并阻碍各层间知识共享。而共享单一表则使每层获得相同嵌入，无法体现层间差异，且实际表现不佳。我们提出Chorus，其中一组n-gram嵌入表服务于整个网络，每层以自身方式读取并处理该表。每层在重新缩放其组件（基于当前隐藏状态计算因子）后，通过自身的投影层对嵌入进行变换。Chorus在仅使用87%小规模表的情况下达到现有n-gram方法的性能水平：12亿参数表的表现优于FactorEngram和DeepSeek Engram（96亿参数）。在从2000万到96亿参数的各种表规模下，Chorus均优于Engram、TN-gram和FactorEngram。我们还发现，最近提出的内存高效优化器Ember与Chorus兼容良好，相比AdamW节省了99.2%的表-优化器内存，且不影响训练性能。这些结果通过降低内存消耗并支持跨层知识复用，为n-gram嵌入表沿表规模方向进一步扩展提供了可能。

summary: A single academic vacancy can draw hundreds of applications, and the first screening round consumes most of a committee's time. We describe a CV Priority Sorter deployed at a national platform for academic vacancies and integrated with its vacancy database. It proposes a reading order for a pile of CVs and leaves every decision to the committee, pairing a frozen multilingual transformer encoder with a per-session linear model that retrains after each label and is discarded when the session ends. It works: on a pool of 300 synthetic CVs, a committee reading in the tool's order reaches 95% of the relevant candidates after half the pile, where an arbitrary order needs almost all of it. This paper is about what we found when we audited that claim, rather than about the system itself. Three findings changed the product. The pool turned out to be sortable by document length alone, which makes precision-style metrics on it uninformative; regenerating it under a shared length budget removes that shortcut and leaves the reading-depth result standing. The four-level agreement score such systems report, ours included, is a binary probability cut at fixed thresholds, so it follows the classifier's confidence rather than its ranking and falls as labels accumulate. And uncertainty sampling, the obvious way to implement a "suggest the next CV" button, leaves model quality intact but raises the committee's total reading load above the no-label baseline, because the CVs it asks about are the ones that would otherwise be skipped. A fourth result shows where to look next: a hosted LLM embedding model lifts zero-label ordinal discrimination from 0.66 to 0.80 under length control, then stops mattering once the session model has two dozen labels; a local cross-encoder matches that cold-start gain without sending data out. We report the fixes each finding forced.
title: Prioritize, Don't Decide: What We Learned Auditing a Deployed Human-in-the-Loop CV Sorter

title_translated: 优先排序，而非决策：我们在部署的人机协同简历筛选系统审计中所学
summary_translated: 一个学术职位空缺可能吸引数百份申请，首轮筛选占用了评审委员会大部分时间。我们描述了一个部署于国家级学术职位平台并集成至职位数据库的简历优先级排序系统。该系统建议简历阅读顺序，但所有决策仍由委员会完成；系统采用冻结的多语言Transformer编码器，搭配每个会话重训练一次的线性模型，会话结束后即丢弃。该系统有效：在300份合成简历池中，按工具推荐顺序阅读，委员会在读完一半简历时已找到95%的相关候选人，而任意顺序则几乎需要全部读完。本文重点并非系统本身，而是对其宣称效果的审计发现。三个关键发现改变了产品设计：原始数据集仅凭文档长度即可排序，使得基于精确率的评估指标失去意义；在统一长度预算下重新生成数据集后，该优势消失，阅读深度结果依然成立。此类系统报告的四层一致性评分本质上是固定阈值下的二分类概率判断，因此反映的是分类器置信度而非排序能力，随着标签积累而下降。不确定性采样虽能保持模型质量，但会使委员会总阅读量超过无标签基线，因为其建议的简历正是原本会被跳过的那些。第四项发现指明了未来方向：托管LLM嵌入模型在控制长度条件下将零标签序数区分度从0.66提升至0.80，但一旦会话模型获得约20个标签后，该优势即消失；本地交叉编码器可在不外发数据的前提下实现相同的冷启动收益。我们报告了每一项发现带来的改进措施。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) now perform strongly on Alan Turing's 1950 Imitation Game, so we propose a harder challenge, the Personal Imitation Game, which asks whether a machine can replicate a specific individual in conversation rather than a generic human. Testing with 30 participants, we establish a human baseline and report the identity signals interrogators rely on: stylometric features, personality traits, and biographical facts. To demonstrate the framework, we design an LLM-based system that plays the game for one of the paper's authors, drawing on an autoethnographic dataset spanning ten years of personal digital communication. In a 20-person deception study, interrogators choose our system over the author's own friends in 7 of 10 rounds, and the author over our system in 13 of 20; neither rate is distinguishable from chance at this sample size. We consider design improvements, applications of personal AI agents, and implications for identity and privacy.
title: Who are you? The Personal Imitation Game

title_translated: 你是谁？个人模仿游戏
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）如今在艾伦·图灵1950年提出的模仿游戏中表现优异，因此我们提出一个更难的挑战——个人模仿游戏，旨在检验机器能否在对话中复现特定个体，而非泛化的人类形象。通过对30名参与者进行测试，我们建立了人类基准，并揭示了审问者依赖的身份线索：风格特征、人格特质和生平事实。为展示该框架，我们设计了一个基于LLM的系统，用于模拟本文作者之一，其数据源自十年间个人数字通信的自传式数据集。在一项20人欺骗实验中，审问者在10轮中有7轮选择我们的系统而非作者的朋友，作者在20轮中有13轮胜过我们的系统；在该样本量下，两者比率均无法与随机猜测区分开来。我们探讨了系统设计改进、个人AI代理的应用前景，以及对身份与隐私的影响。

summary: Large language model (LLM) judges have become a common way to create large-scale relevance judgments for retrieval evaluation. However, each judgment requires a potentially expensive call to a frontier model, and the judgments are hard to interpret and may not be reproducible. In this paper, we ask whether an LLM can write a readable program for each topic that replaces its per-document judgments. To address these issues, we propose ExecJudges, a method for generating fast, inspectable and scalable judges for automatic relevance labeling. Specifically, ExecJudges uses a frontier LLM to turn assessment guidelines into executable programs, which rely only on lexical matching, standard NLP libraries like parsers, and pool statistics. An ExecJudges-L variant also uses examples of human labels if available. We evaluate ExecJudges on seven TREC collections by comparing the produced labels with trained NIST assessors, frontier LLM judges, and recently proposed per-topic classifiers. Our results show that ExecJudges agrees with NIST assessors at the level of the Claude Sonnet 5.5 LLM judges on TREC DL 2019-2021. With a small number of human labels per topic, the ExecJudges-L variant agrees with NIST more than per-topic classifiers with the same labels on all seven collections, and either exceeds the agreement of LLM judges provided the same labels or is within about 0.05 of it in Krippendorff's alpha. The labels rank the official TREC DL runs with Kendall's tau of 0.87 to 0.94, and writing the programs incurs a one-time cost of $0.17 to $0.49 per topic, with no additional costs for grading. Our results suggest that ExecJudges offers a reproducible, inspectable, efficient and cost-effective alternative to LLM judges for labeling deep result pools for system evaluation or ranking improvements.
title: Can Programs Replace LLM Judges? Executable Program Judges for Scalable and Efficient Relevance Labeling
title_translated: 程序能否替代LLM裁判？可执行程序裁判用于可扩展高效的相关性标注
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）裁判已成为大规模检索评估相关性标注的常用方式。然而，每次标注都需要调用前沿模型，成本较高，且标注结果难以解释，可能不可复现。本文探讨：LLM是否能为每个主题生成可读的程序，以替代其逐文档的判断？为此，我们提出ExecJudges，一种用于自动相关性标注的快速、可检查、可扩展的裁判生成方法。具体而言，ExecJudges利用前沿LLM将评估指南转化为可执行程序，这些程序仅依赖词汇匹配、标准NLP库（如解析器）和统计池信息。ExecJudges-L变体在有可用人类标注示例时还会加以利用。我们在七个TREC数据集上评估ExecJudges，将其生成的标注与训练的NIST评估员、前沿LLM裁判及近期提出的每主题分类器进行比较。结果显示，ExecJudges在TREC DL 2019–2021上的标注与Claude Sonnet 5.5 LLM裁判一致。在每主题少量人工标注情况下，ExecJudges-L在所有七个数据集上比同量标注的每主题分类器更接近NIST评估员，且在提供相同标注的情况下，其Krippendorff's alpha值要么超过LLM裁判，要么相差不超过0.05。生成的标注在官方TREC DL运行结果中的排名相关性（Kendall's tau）为0.87至0.94，编写程序的一次性成本为每主题0.17至0.49美元，后续无额外评分成本。结果表明，ExecJudges为系统评估或排序优化中深层结果池的标注提供了一种可复现、可检查、高效且低成本的替代方案。

summary: Existing AI agents can retrieve information, call tools, run experiments, and produce multi-step outputs. Yet most are built around relatively static workflows and struggle to preserve reliable state as the environment changes. Financial trading makes this limitation especially consequential: prices, news, market conditions, portfolio positions, and available capital evolve continuously. A result is useful only when it remains tied to the correct time, data snapshot, and execution context. We present Vibe-Trading, a comprehensive agent-native trading framework and all-in-one workspace for building, evaluating, and evolving agents for financial trading. It unifies market research, financial data, strategy generation, backtesting, portfolio analysis, paper trading, multi-agent collaboration, and optional broker execution. Its central contribution is an architecture that keeps results, evidence, research history, and trading authority connected throughout the research-to-action process. Each result retains its source, temporal scope, configuration, and producing run. Shared evidence grounding enables verification, versioned research records support reproducible continuation, and an explicit authority gate separates strategy research from live execution. Together, these designs provide a practical foundation for trading agents whose results can be traced, reproduced, and acted on only under explicit authority.
title: Vibe-Trading: Towards Agent-Native Trading

title_translated: Vibe-Trading：迈向原生智能体交易
summary_translated: 现有AI智能体能够检索信息、调用工具、运行实验并生成多步输出。然而，大多数仍围绕相对静态的工作流构建，在环境变化时难以维持可靠状态。金融交易尤其凸显这一局限：价格、新闻、市场状况、投资组合持仓和可用资金持续演变。结果的有效性取决于其是否与正确的时间点、数据快照和执行上下文绑定。我们提出Vibe-Trading，一个全面的原生智能体交易框架及一体化工作空间，用于构建、评估和演化金融交易智能体。它整合了市场研究、金融数据、策略生成、回测、投资组合分析、模拟交易、多智能体协作以及可选的券商执行功能。其核心贡献是一种架构，确保从研究到行动全过程中的结果、证据、研究历史和交易权限始终关联。每个结果保留其来源、时间范围、配置和生成运行信息。共享证据基础支持验证，版本化研究记录支持可复现的延续，显式的权限门控机制将策略研究与实时执行分离。这些设计共同为交易智能体提供了实用基础，使其结果可追溯、可复现，并仅在明确授权下才可执行。

summary: Visualizing intermediate representations could help us inspect the reasoning steps underlying a model output. Unified multimodal models offer this opportunity by combining understanding and generation in one architecture. Their image generators can access representations formed while processing text. We introduce the V-lens, which uses this connection to visualize a chosen token's hidden state without training a decoder. Across four diffusion-based and two purely autoregressive unified models, the resulting images reveal key intermediate concepts that connect a question to its answer even when the concepts are never named explicitly. Controlled tests show how this content changes with context, token position, and depth. We then introduce lens tuning, which supervises selected hidden states with pictures through the V-lens. Across BAGEL, SenseNova-U1, and HunyuanImage-3.0, the rate of correct visualizations of pronoun referents rises from 2-11% to 86-94%. Surprisingly, such visual supervision also improves text answers without supervising the answer tokens directly. Code is available at https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/V-lens.
title: The Elephant in the Question: Unified Models Picture the Concepts Behind Their Answers

title_translated: 问题中的大象：统一模型描绘其答案背后的概念
summary_translated: 可视化中间表示有助于我们检查模型输出背后的推理过程。统一的多模态模型通过在一个架构中结合理解与生成，提供了这一机会。它们的图像生成器可以访问处理文本时形成的表示。我们提出了V-lens，利用这一连接在不训练解码器的情况下可视化选定标记的隐藏状态。在四个基于扩散和两个纯自回归的统一模型中，生成的图像揭示了将问题与其答案联系起来的关键中间概念，即使这些概念从未被明确命名。受控测试显示，这些内容如何随上下文、标记位置和深度变化。随后我们引入了镜头调优（lens tuning），通过V-lens使用图像对选定的隐藏状态进行监督。在BAGEL、SenseNova-U1和HunyuanImage-3.0上，代词指代正确可视化的比例从2%-11%提升至86%-94%。令人惊讶的是，这种视觉监督也无需直接监督答案标记即可改善文本答案。代码已公开于https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/V-lens。

summary: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/
title: DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving

title_translated: DRIFT：可拆卸推理实现运行时灵活且高效的端到端驾驶
summary_translated: 将视觉语言模型（VLM）集成到端到端（E2E）自动驾驶中展示了强大的潜力，能够提供场景描述和推理能力。然而，VLM计算成本高，且在运行时开关语言推理而不影响闭环性能尚未得到验证，这阻碍了实际应用。为解决这些问题，我们提出DRIFT，一种集成轻量级语言模型（LM）用于视觉问答和动作评论的E2E自动驾驶框架。通过高效地将中间驾驶表示投影到语言嵌入空间，我们证明一个紧凑的LM（<150M参数）能够实现强大的场景描述和动作评论。此外，我们引入了一个运行时灵活的规划模块，该模块在从LM中提炼出的代理推理特征上进行训练，并可在推理时根据LM或代理推理特征进行条件控制。这种设计使得在部署约束要求下可完全绕过LM，而不会牺牲驾驶性能。仅使用255M参数，DRIFT在Bench2Drive上以选定推理率交替使用LM和代理推理，达到最高97.03的驾驶评分（DS）和89.39%的成功率（三次运行平均值）。这与最强的非语言模型相当，但远比现有的基于VLM的模型更紧凑。DRIFT在真实世界的NAVSIM和AlpaSim基准测试中也取得了具有竞争力的结果，且计算成本显著低于现有基于VLM的方法。项目页面：https://drift-e2e.github.io/

summary: Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. Every observation states the complete scoring rule, and each of the 178 difficulty levels is calibrated: it is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the strongest plausible non-deductive policy on at most 0.25 and each gated shortcut on at most 0.35. The 92 core levels span all 27 families and are sized to train small models; the 86 frontier rungs extend the 15 discovery worlds with harder questions and with campaigns of three, five and eight or more committed stages on one hidden system. On the same 84 withheld frontier instances, one per family and rung, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solves 32 at its default reasoning effort with 16,384 tokens per call and 57 at its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call (oracle: 79); the headroom that remains is largest in eight-stage campaigns. On-policy expert iteration gives a 9B model modest gains: its core-tier success on trained families rises from 0.090 to 0.148, partly through better action format, with no detectable loss on GPQA Diamond. A hosted service plays the core tier's withheld instances.
title: Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents

title_translated: Openhagen世界：用于测量与训练科学发现智能体的校准环境
summary_translated: 能够进行科学研究的智能体必须选择信息丰富的实验并从结果中推理，但大多数发现基准无法将这一技能与记忆检索、未说明的评分规则或捷径策略区分开来。我们引入了Openhagen世界，一套由27个程序生成环境组成的套件（部分具有有限真值空间），涵盖经典实验推理谜题以及模拟器驱动的物理和化学场景。在预算限制下，智能体运行实验并提交答案，由确定性验证器根据隐藏真值进行检查。每个观测都完整陈述了评分规则，且178个难度级别均经过校准：只有当在64个开发实例上，脚本化预言者成功率达到至少0.75，最强的合理非演绎策略成功率不超过0.25，每种受控捷径成功率不超过0.35时才被接受。92个核心层级覆盖全部27个类别，适合训练小型模型；86个前沿层级则扩展了15个发现世界，包含更难的问题以及针对单一隐藏系统的三阶段、五阶段及八阶段以上的任务序列。在相同的84个保留前沿实例上（每类每层级各一个），DeepSeek V4.1 Flash在默认推理努力下（每次调用16,384个token）解决了32个，在最大努力下（每次调用最多393,216个token）解决了57个（预言者：79个）；剩余提升空间在八阶段任务序列中最大。基于策略的专家迭代为9B模型带来了适度提升：其在训练家族的核心层级成功率从0.090提高到0.148，部分得益于更好的动作格式，且在GPQA钻石任务上无明显损失。托管服务可运行核心层级的保留实例。

summary: Small language models (SLMs) can run on commodity hardware and support privacy-preserving, on-premises clinical deployment, but their medical explanations are often short and poorly structured compared with large language models. Recent supervised approaches such as Meerkat transfer chain-of-thought reasoning into 7B-8B backbones, yet their training objective does not directly target the style or organization of the generated rationales. Building on the instruction-tuned Mistral-7B backbone, we investigate whether a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) step can improve explanation structure without human preference labels.We apply Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with LoRA adaptation to 2,000 Meerkat-derived medical prompts, guided by a simple self-supervised reward that favors longer, lexically diverse, and well-punctuated responses while penalizing very short ones. Training for about 170 PPO steps on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU yields a stable increase in the average reward. Quantitative and qualitative comparisons show that the RL-tuned model produces longer, more organized, multi-point explanations while preserving the underlying medical content.We discuss the promise and the limitations of self-rewarded RL for shaping the style of medical explanations.
title: Self-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Better-Structured Medical Explanations in Small Language Models

title_translated: 自奖励强化学习提升小语言模型的结构化医学解释能力
summary_translated: 小语言模型（SLMs）可在通用硬件上运行，并支持隐私保护、本地部署的临床应用，但其医学解释通常较短且结构不佳，相较于大语言模型。近期的监督方法如Meerkat将思维链推理迁移到7B-8B的骨干模型中，但其训练目标并未直接针对生成推理的风格或组织结构。基于指令微调的Mistral-7B骨干模型，我们研究是否可通过轻量级强化学习（RL）步骤在无需人类偏好标签的情况下改善解释结构。我们在2,000个来自Meerkat的医学提示上应用近端策略优化（PPO）并结合LoRA适配，采用一种简单的自监督奖励机制，鼓励更长、词汇多样性更高、标点更规范的响应，同时惩罚过短的回答。在单块NVIDIA A100 GPU上训练约170个PPO步骤后，平均奖励稳定上升。定量与定性比较表明，RL调优后的模型生成更长、更有条理、多要点的解释，同时保持底层医学内容不变。我们讨论了自奖励RL在塑造医学解释风格方面的潜力与局限。

summary: During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.
title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models

title_translated: 将人类大脑组织分析迁移至语言模型
summary_translated: 在人类皮层发育过程中，功能系统逐渐分化。我们探讨语言模型推理能力的提升是否涉及类似的区域重组。对三个模型家族的匹配基础模型和推理训练模型应用扩散图嵌入（用于表征皮层组织的方法），我们发现梯度分布总体保持稳定，但在连续层内存在局部变化。将这些区域的权重移植到指令微调的主机模型中，平均提升了数学推理能力，增益随区域重叠程度增加，且相比其他区域的移植，保留了更多先前已解决的问题。在整个训练过程中，该区域在性能早期上升阶段逐渐形成，中间阶段的移植也有效。移植使多数主机部分向其源模型的行为靠拢，有时甚至在源模型失败的问题上表现更好；同一分析方法也在一个医学模型中定位到了可转移的区域。这些发现共同识别出一个与推理相关的区域，其权重能在低干扰的前提下提升推理能力，同时保持主机原有的数学能力。

summary: AI agents read their whole history at every step. People do not work like that: we keep what the moment needs and hold the rest as a rough note we can recall. MoE-Context applies this to language models. The context is split into blocks. Before each step a fast yes or no pass decides which blocks the step needs; the rest stay as one-line notes that can be brought back, and nothing is deleted. In the version we build, one model makes this decision and then answers, over a single key-value cache where hidden blocks are masked rather than removed. On a laptop with Qwen3-1.7B and a synthetic lookup task, showing only the needed block raises accuracy from 93 to 119 of 120, and a masked block is as hidden as a deleted one. The model's own picking is the weak part. A supervised linear probe written into spare output rows lifts its accuracy from 80 to 110 of 120, but simple keyword search picks perfectly on this task, and the probe does not transfer to a second task. We report these results openly, along with two cheap usage patterns that block switching enables: undoing a failed attempt and running subagents without a new context.
title: MoE-Context: Show the Model Only What It Needs

title_translated: MoE-Context：只向模型展示它需要的内容
summary_translated: AI智能体在每一步都会读取其完整的历史记录。而人类并非如此：我们只保留当下所需的信息，其余内容则作为可回忆的粗略笔记。MoE-Context将这一理念应用于语言模型。上下文被划分为多个块，在每一步之前，通过快速的“是/否”判断决定哪些块是当前步骤所需的；其余部分则以单行笔记形式保留，必要时可重新调用，且不会被删除。在我们构建的版本中，一个模型负责做出该决策并生成回答，整个过程仅使用单一键值缓存，隐藏的块通过掩码而非删除实现。在配备Qwen3-1.7B模型的笔记本电脑上，针对合成查找任务，仅展示所需块使准确率从93提升至120中的119，而掩码块的效果与删除块相当。模型自身的选择能力是薄弱环节。通过在空闲输出行中加入监督线性探测器，其准确率从80提升至120中的110，但简单关键词搜索在此任务上表现完美，且探测器无法迁移到第二个任务。我们公开报告这些结果，并提出两种由块切换带来的低成本使用模式：撤销失败尝试、在不创建新上下文的情况下运行子智能体。

summary: Counting complexity within the Holant framework has been extensively studied through complexity dichotomy theorems. While substantial progress has been achieved for various restricted settings, the general complex-valued even-arity case without auxiliary unary signatures remains largely open. This paper studies a fundamental case in this program where the binary signatures induce a group structure satisfying \(M(B(\mathcal{F}))\cong C_2\). It is observed that projective equivalence classes of binary signature matrices naturally embed into finite subgroups of \(SO(3)\), providing an algebraic viewpoint for structural classification. This paper further identifies two fundamentally different regimes for the \(C_2\) case, namely the normal and isotropic cases, and analyzes their complexity behavior separately.   Combining gadget constructions, decomposition techniques, interpolation arguments, and a realnumberization approach that transforms the complex-valued setting into an equivalent real-structured framework, this paper establishes a complete dichotomy theorem: for every even-arity signature set \(\mathcal{F}\) satisfying \(M(\B(\mathcal{F}))\cong C_2\), the problem \(\mathrm{Holant}(\mathcal{F})\) is either polynomial-time computable or \#P-hard. A Pauli-basis representation for signatures is further introduced as an algebraically natural language for organizing realizable signatures and revealing structural relations that are less transparent in the standard basis.
title: From a finite subgroup of $SO(3)$:$C_2$ leads to a Holant dichotomy
title_translated: 从SO(3)的有限子群出发：C₂导致Holant二分定理
summary_translated: 在Holant框架内，计数复杂性已通过复杂性二分定理得到广泛研究。尽管在多种受限设置下取得了显著进展，但无辅助一元签名的通用复数值偶数阶情形仍基本开放。本文研究了该研究计划中的一个基础情形，即二元签名诱导出满足M(B(F))≅C₂的群结构。观察到二元签名矩阵的投影等价类自然嵌入SO(3)的有限子群中，为结构分类提供了代数视角。本文进一步识别出C₂情形下的两种根本不同的情形——正常情形与各向同性情形，并分别分析其复杂性行为。结合构造工具、分解技术、插值论证以及将复数值设定转化为等价实结构框架的实化方法，本文建立了完整的二分定理：对于每一个满足M(B(F))≅C₂的偶数阶签名集F，问题Holant(F)要么可在多项式时间内计算，要么是#P难的。此外，引入了基于泡利基的签名表示法，作为一种代数上自然的语言，用于组织可实现的签名并揭示标准基中不明显的结构性关系。

summary: We present a novel approach to the problem of combining two voice-line channels of dyadic conversational audio into a unified conversation with controllable back-channeling and turn-taking dynamics. In voice performances for the game industry, the two tracks of voice-lines are typically recorded or synthesized in isolation. Our method takes two such unsynchronized tracks and uses a neural scheduler to sequence them into a single dynamic conversation, modifying both tracks by inserting or removing pauses and introducing voice overlap as appropriate. We further propose a back-channel predictor that is able to predict opportunity for back-channels for a given conversational turn's audio and content, which the scheduler can then incorporate. We evaluate our scheduler and predictor independently and in combination by: various quantitative comparison; a qualitative and perceptual comparison to prior art and naive baselines; a compelling set of results showing animator control over the diversity, extent and nature of back-channeling and turn dynamics.
title: Constructing Dynamic Conversations with Neural Back-channel Generation and Voice-line Scheduling

title_translated: 通过神经后通道生成与语音线路调度构建动态对话
summary_translated: 我们提出一种新颖方法，将两个独立的双人对话音频语音线路合并为一个具有可控后通道和发言权动态的统一对话。在游戏行业的声音表演中，两条语音线路通常被孤立地录制或合成。我们的方法接收这两条未同步的线路，利用神经调度器将其序列化为一条动态对话，通过插入或移除停顿、适当地引入语音重叠来修改两条线路。我们还提出了一个后通道预测器，能够根据给定对话回合的音频和内容预测后通道出现的机会，调度器可据此进行整合。我们通过多种定量比较、定性与感知对比（与先前工作及朴素基线相比），以及一组令人信服的结果，评估了调度器与预测器的独立性能及其组合效果，展示了动画师对后通道多样性、程度和性质的精细控制能力。

summary: VLA policies are fragile to rewording. Success rates alone cannot say whether a policy fails to choose the object or to complete the task, nor where in the policy to intervene. We study the released GR00T N1.7 on two LIBERO-Spatial tasks differing only in the landmark word telling which of two bowls to take. Synonyms absent from the training instructions send the policy to the bowl they name, unlike made-up words, yet complete 67.6% of one task's closed-loop episodes, against the original word's 100%. Before the connector between the vision-language model and the action generator, replacing only the landmark tokens' vectors with the other landmark's (pasting) sends nearly every episode to the other bowl. After the connector, pasting at the landmark, the remaining instruction, or the image tokens alone rarely moves the choice, but any two do. Hiding the landmark tokens from the action generator after the connector still lowers completion for the synonyms that fall short. Finetuning on diversified landmark words repairs that one task's completion for synonyms absent from finetuning; finetuning on the original instructions does not. Training only the connector on the diversified words suffices, as does copying the connector of a policy fully finetuned on them into one finetuned on the original instructions. An open-loop score on starting frames misses that weights outside the connector also carry part of the repair. For now, on this evidence, robustness to rewording should be judged in closed loop, with actions executed, intervening on both sides of the connector, scoring choice and completion separately.
title: Meaning Reaches Object Choice but Not Completion: Where Is a VLA Vulnerable to Landmark Synonyms?

title_translated: 语义影响对象选择但不影响任务完成：VLA在何处易受地标同义词干扰？
summary_translated: VLA策略对措辞变化极为脆弱。仅凭成功率无法判断策略是未能选择目标对象，还是未能完成任务，也无法定位干预点。我们研究了在两个仅在地标词上不同的LIBERO-Spatial任务中发布的GR00T N1.7模型。训练指令中未包含的同义词会引导策略选择其所命名的碗，而虚构词汇则不会，尽管后者仍能完成67.6%的闭环任务周期，远高于原词的100%。在视觉-语言模型与动作生成器之间的连接器之前，仅将地标词向量替换为另一地标词（粘贴）几乎会使所有任务实例导向另一个碗。在连接器之后，仅在地标词、剩余指令或图像标记上进行粘贴，很少改变选择结果，但任意两个同时操作则会改变。在连接器之后隐藏地标标记仍会降低那些表现不佳的同义词的任务完成率。在多样化地标词上进行微调可修复该任务中缺失同义词的完成率；而在原始指令上微调则无效。仅在多样化词汇上训练连接器即可，或将一个在多样化词汇上完全微调的策略的连接器复制到在原始指令上微调的策略中也足够。开环起始帧评分忽略了连接器外权重也承担部分修复作用。基于此证据，目前应通过执行动作的闭环方式评估对措辞变化的鲁棒性，同时在连接器两侧进行干预，并分别评分选择与完成情况。

summary: Long-context large language model (LLM) services charge for repeated context, yet billing weights need not reflect its contribution to answer quality. We present a three-layer framework separating content relevance, observable proxies and auditable positional weights. Context-ablation experiments show that relevance dominates position and that distance-decay families do not outperform a relevance-only baseline. A measured serving stack shows that cache hits reduce repeated-prefix compute cost by over two orders of magnitude at 65,536 tokens, while cold resends constrain sustainable discounts. Cross-provider measurements separate cache value from tokenisation and list-price differences. Calibrated simulations reduce the 99th percentile of session charges by 31-42%, although revenue-matched nonlinear tariffs achieve similar reductions and median charges increase. The framework provides a bounded per-token accounting rule and measured deployment constraints, rather than a validated utility estimator.
title: Measuring and Charging for Retained Context in Long-Context LLM Services

title_translated: 测量与收费：长上下文LLM服务中的保留上下文
summary_translated: 长上下文大语言模型（LLM）服务对重复上下文收费，但计费权重未必反映其对答案质量的实际贡献。我们提出一个三层框架，将内容相关性、可观测代理和可审计的位置权重分离。上下文消融实验表明，相关性主导位置因素，且距离衰减类模型并不优于仅依赖相关性的基线。实测服务栈显示，在65,536个token时，缓存命中将重复前缀的计算成本降低了两个数量级以上，而冷重发限制了可持续折扣。跨服务商测量分离了缓存价值与分词和定价差异。校准模拟将会话费用的99百分位降低31%-42%，尽管收入匹配的非线性费率也能实现类似降低，但中位数费用上升。该框架提供了一个有界每token会计规则和实测部署约束，而非经过验证的效用估计器。

summary: Existing latent reasoners typically run for a preset latent horizon during inference. Intuitively, a longer horizon should provide more opportunity for reasoning. However, in this work, we find that extending latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to the full preset horizon may in fact degrade reasoning performance. We observe that latent CoT evolves through distinct functional stages, with earlier computation forming frontier reasoning states, while later computation mainly reorganizes existing candidates and can weaken gold candidate support. These findings motivate a rethink of fixed-horizon latent inference. To address this, we characterize the reasoning benefits of latent CoT by realized and remaining constructive progress. Empirically, we find that higher realized constructive progress corresponds to higher current reasoning accuracy, while more remaining progress corresponds to larger future gains from continued latent CoT. To this end, we introduce a lightweight method that estimates the remaining reasoning progress and adaptively adjusts the latent horizon during inference. Across representative latent CoT reasoners and multiple arithmetic benchmarks, our method improves reasoning accuracy by up to 7.2 percentage points while reducing latent computation by up to 29.0%, without retraining the LLM.
title: Rethinking Fixed-Horizon Latent Reasoning

title_translated: 重新思考固定时域的潜在推理
summary_translated: 现有的潜在推理模型通常在推理过程中运行预设的潜在时域。直觉上，更长的时域应提供更多的推理机会。然而，本研究发现，将潜在思维链（CoT）扩展到完整的预设时域实际上可能降低推理性能。我们观察到，潜在CoT会经历不同的功能阶段，早期计算形成前沿推理状态，而后期计算主要对现有候选进行重组，可能削弱正确候选的支持。这些发现促使我们重新思考固定时域的潜在推理。为此，我们通过已实现和剩余的建设性进展来刻画潜在CoT的推理收益。实证结果表明，更高的已实现建设性进展对应更高的当前推理准确率，而更多的剩余进展则意味着持续潜在CoT带来的更大未来增益。为此，我们提出一种轻量级方法，用于估计剩余推理进度，并在推理过程中自适应调整潜在时域。在多个代表性潜在CoT推理器和算术基准测试中，该方法在不重新训练大语言模型的前提下，推理准确率最高提升7.2个百分点，同时潜在计算量减少最多达29.0%。

summary: A System 1 model answers a multiple-choice question in a single pass. A frozen language model turns the question and each option into vectors, two small, trained heads place them in a shared space, and the closest option wins. The design has been shown on agent decisions, but we are not aware of a study of how far it goes on exam questions that need medical knowledge, where the right option is often no more similar to the question than the wrong ones. We rebuilt the recipe from scratch for MedMCQA and trained only two projection heads and one temperature on top of frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B, Granite-4.2-3B and Qwen3-8B, using a contrastive loss with in-batch and hard negatives and a mask for repeated answers. With plain last-token vectors, both small encoders answer about one question in three correctly (33.1% and 33.0% on 3,842 held-out questions, where chance is 25.0%). Writing each text inside a one-word-summary prompt and lowering the learning rate of the heads raised this to 41.7% and 42.5% for the two small encoders and to 46.0% +-0.2 (three seeds) for Qwen3-8B. Shuffling the questions against the options returns accuracy to chance, so the heads do use the question. Flan-PaLM and Med-PaLM 2 report 57.6% and 72.3% on MedMCQA under a different protocol, so ours is a cheap, fast baseline and not a competitive system. We also say what our evidence cannot show: validation gains were about 1.7 to 2 times the test gains, and we could not separate the effect of reading several encoder layers from the other changes.
title: A System 1 Decision Model for Medical Multiple-Choice Questions Built on Frozen Language Models

title_translated: 基于冻结语言模型构建医疗多选题的系统1决策模型
summary_translated: 系统1模型以单次遍历的方式回答多选题。本研究使用冻结的语言模型将问题和每个选项转化为向量，通过两个小型训练头将其映射到共享空间，最近的选项获胜。该设计已在智能体决策中得到验证，但我们尚不清楚其在需要医学知识的考试题目中的表现——因为正确选项与问题的相似度往往并不高于错误选项。我们从零开始重构该方法，针对MedMCQA数据集，在冻结的Qwen3.5-0.8B、Granite-4.2-3B和Qwen3-8B基础上仅训练两个投影头和一个温度参数，采用批内和困难负样本的对比损失，并引入重复答案掩码。使用原始的最后token向量，两个小型编码器在3,842个保留问题上的准确率约为33.1%和33.0%（随机猜测为25.0%）。通过在每个文本前添加一句话摘要提示并降低头部的学习率，小型编码器的准确率分别提升至41.7%和42.5%，Qwen3-8B达到46.0%±0.2（三个种子）。打乱问题与选项的配对后准确率回落至随机水平，说明训练头确实利用了问题信息。Flan-PaLM和Med-PaLM 2在不同协议下于MedMCQA上报告的准确率为57.6%和72.3%，因此我们的方法是一个低成本、快速的基线，而非竞争性系统。此外，我们指出证据无法揭示的内容：验证增益约为测试增益的1.7至2倍，且无法区分读取多个编码器层与其他变化的影响。

summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) generation models write a graphic as code with one forward pass per token, so drawing is slow. Speculative decoding speeds them up losslessly, and block drafters guess many tokens per pass. On SVG, many of their rounds accept the whole draft and end only at the verification window. We find that their misses are rare and clumped, and that they stay accurate far deeper into a block than on natural language. A run-length identity and three propositions show that a longer window pays once the candidates are wide, up to the drafter's horizon. We propose Sightline, which pairs a window as long as the drafter's horizon with a draft tree wide enough to fill it. Experiments cover text-to-SVG and image-to-SVG with three models on six benchmarks from MMSVG, MMSVG-2M and SArena. In every setting, Sightline is the fastest of the compared lossless decoders. On SArena, it stays the fastest when every decoder shares one loop control. It also leads in almost every setting of six models from four other families, which write SVG code, compressed SVG tokens or Lottie JSON. Analyses trace the lead to rounds that shorter windows cut off, both in loop-free content and in loops. Speculative decoding also saves time for choosing samples by rendering, which beats choosing by likelihood. These results suggest that speculative decoding on vector graphics should verify as far as the drafter sees. Code and data are available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Sightline.
title: Sightline: Long-Window Speculative Decoding for Fast SVG Generation

title_translated: Sightline：用于快速SVG生成的长窗口推测解码
summary_translated: 可扩展矢量图形（SVG）生成模型通过每token一次前向传播写入图形代码，导致绘图过程缓慢。推测解码可无损加速这一过程，块式草稿器每轮预测多个token。在SVG生成中，许多轮次会接受整个草稿，仅在验证窗口结束。我们发现其失败情况稀少且集中，且在块内保持准确的深度远超自然语言。运行长度恒等性和三项命题表明，一旦候选范围足够宽，更长的窗口即能带来收益，直至草稿器的视野极限。我们提出Sightline，将与草稿器视野等长的窗口与足够宽的草稿树配对，以填满该窗口。实验涵盖来自MMSVG、MMSVG-2M和SArena的六个基准上的文本到SVG和图像到SVG任务，涉及三种模型。在所有设置中，Sightline是所比较的无损解码器中最快的。在SArena上，即使所有解码器共享同一循环控制，Sightline仍保持最快。在来自四个其他家族的六种模型（生成SVG代码、压缩SVG token或Lottie JSON）的几乎所有设置中也领先。分析表明，领先源于短窗口过早截断的回合，包括无循环内容和循环结构。推测解码还通过渲染选择样本节省时间，优于基于似然的选择。这些结果表明，矢量图形上的推测解码应尽可能验证至草稿器所能看见的范围。代码与数据可在https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Sightline获取。

summary: Rigid motion of a patient head during head cone-beam CT (CBCT) scan can degrade image quality and complicate recovery of accurate anatomical structures from the measured projections. We present a 3D flow-matching prior approach that learns the image changes induced by motion. Its geometry-bridge connects motion-corrupted and motion-free Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstructed images of the same source volume through progressively reduced simulated motion. The forward projector's geometry derivative supplies analytic velocity targets along this path. A plug-and-play loop encompasses the learned image updates together with spline-based pose estimation, conjugate-gradient data consistency, and image total-variation regularization. Both the refined image volume and the FDK reconstructed image volume at the estimated poses are evaluated. On simulated 360-view scans from 30 held-out CQ500 patients with nominal per-component motion amplitudes within 10 mm / 10 degrees, the framework achieved state-of-the-art image reconstruction quality and motion accuracy in comparison with other methos such as learned autofocus and diffusion-based joint reconstruction. Mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) reached 37.1 dB and mean detector-plane reprojection error (RPE) was 0.27 mm. With matched endpoints at the inference settings, the geometry bridge improved PSNR by 1.6 dB and reduced RPE by 33% relative to image-linear training. With 50 prior updates and coarse-to-fine motion estimation, total processing time averaged 9.1 minutes per patient on an RTX A6000.
title: Geometry-bridge flow matching for blind rigid-motion correction in head cone-beam CT
title_translated: 几何桥流匹配用于头部锥束CT中的盲刚性运动校正
summary_translated: 患者头部在头部锥束CT（CBCT）扫描期间的刚性运动会降低图像质量，并使从测量投影中恢复精确解剖结构变得复杂。我们提出一种三维流匹配先验方法，学习由运动引起的图像变化。其几何桥通过逐步减小的模拟运动，连接同一源体积的运动污染与无运动的Feldkamp-Davis-Kress（FDK）重建图像。前向投影器的几何导数提供了沿该路径的解析速度目标。一个即插即用的循环包含学习到的图像更新、基于样条的姿态估计、共轭梯度数据一致性以及图像总变差正则化。评估了在估计姿态下的精炼图像体积和FDK重建图像体积。在30名CQ500患者的360视角模拟扫描中，各分量运动幅度在10 mm / 10度以内，该框架在图像重建质量和运动精度方面均达到当前最优水平，优于诸如学习自动对焦和基于扩散的联合重建等方法。平均峰值信噪比（PSNR）达到37.1 dB，平均探测器平面重投影误差（RPE）为0.27 mm。在推理设置匹配终点的情况下，相较于图像线性训练，几何桥提升了1.6 dB的PSNR，并将RPE降低了33%。在50次先验更新和粗到细运动估计下，单例患者平均处理时间为9.1分钟（RTX A6000）。

summary: Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. At run time, compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 when confidence falls below a calibrated threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 model families, AnyS1 preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent, and maintains performance under zero-shot threshold transfer.
title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow

title_translated: 快速思考，随处可用：适用于任何智能体工作流决策点的统一系统1
summary_translated: 自主的大语言模型（LLM）智能体在每一步都调用大型模型（系统2），即使许多中间动作仅需在少量已知候选中做出选择，也会产生显著的成本和延迟。现有双系统智能体将此类决策卸载给轻量级系统1模型，但依赖于按环境定制的特定工作流钩子。我们提出AnyS1，一种将人类编写的程序技能转化为共享、通用领域决策点来源的框架。这些技能的指令天然指明了选择出现的位置及适用选项。离线阶段，AnyS1挖掘超过1,000个公开技能中的具体可枚举决策，收集隔离容器内的执行基础轨迹状态，构建Any-DP，并训练一个经过标签平滑校准的4B指针型系统1。运行时，编译后的工作流通过一次前向传播解决常规决策，并在置信度低于校准阈值时回退至系统2。在三个未见基准及不同系统2模型族中，AnyS1在保持任务可靠性的同时，将任务成本降低75%-91%，模型调用时间减少63%-92%，并在零样本阈值迁移下维持性能。

summary: Small language models on devices could keep improving by learning, overnight, from their own daily work. Without a true outcome, however, something must decide which attempts are worth learning from, and both the model's own judgment and the user's reaction can be wrong. We study a small model (Qwen3 0.6B and 1.7B) with a LoRA adapter, fine-tuned each night on the attempts a judge accepts, over 127 lives of up to a year on WebShop and $τ^2$-bench. We compare the true outcome, the user's stated verdict and the model's own judgment with a separate, frozen "feedback sense" that reads the user's reaction, built in three versions. Judging itself, the model improved and then decayed, over a year and whatever its adapter. A sense that took polite give-ups for success collapsed 3 of 5 lives; one built for discernment, which first asks whether the user gave a clear verdict, kept 4 of 5 near the oracle for two weeks, then faded on clean but scarce lessons, to the level of self-judging by day 60. When the user cannot see the outcome ($τ^2$-bench), the sense read reactions correctly, yet 80% of its lessons were failures the customer had thanked. Across 97 lives, the share of failed attempts among the lessons predicted the outcome (Spearman $ρ$ = -0.81). In our experiments, learning from users held up only where the judge kept failures out and the user could see the outcome; lopsided lessons may also narrow the model.
title: Learning through Discernment: when a small language model learns from user feedback on the job, and when it decays

summary_translated: 设备上的小型语言模型可以通过夜间自主学习其日常任务中的经验持续改进。然而，在没有真实结果的情况下，必须有某种机制判断哪些尝试值得学习，而模型自身的判断和用户的反应都可能出错。我们研究了一个小型模型（Qwen3 0.6B 和 1.7B），使用LoRA适配器，在WebShop和$τ^2$-bench上经过127次长达一年的生命周期，每晚基于裁判接受的尝试进行微调。我们将真实结果、用户声明的裁决和模型自身判断与一个独立的、冻结的“反馈感知”模块进行比较，该模块以三种版本构建，用于解读用户的反应。模型自我判断时，其性能先提升后退化，持续一年且不受适配器影响。一种将礼貌放弃视为成功的感知模块导致5条生命中有3条崩溃；而一种强调辨别力的感知模块，首先询问用户是否给出明确裁决，能在两周内保持接近最优的表现，随后因缺乏清晰但稀少的学习样本而逐渐衰减，到第60天时表现降至与自我判断相当水平。当用户无法看到结果（$τ^2$-bench）时，该感知模块能正确读取反应，但80%的教训来自客户表示感谢的失败尝试。在97次实验中，失败尝试在教训中的占比与真实结果呈显著负相关（Spearman $ρ$ = -0.81）。我们的实验表明，只有在裁判排除失败案例且用户可见结果的情况下，从用户反馈中学习才有效；不均衡的教训也可能缩小模型能力范围。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for improving language-model agents on long-horizon tasks, yet its conventional formulation relies on teacher logits that text-only black- box models do not expose. To address this limitation, we introduce Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD), which uses natural-language communication as a medium for distilling a stronger model's capabilities into a smaller student. During task execution, the student au- tonomously decides when to consult a black-box teacher and formulates open-ended natural- language requests without predefined question templates or intervention schedules. Successful student-teacher interactions are retained as privileged references to supervise fresh adviser-free student rollouts through on-policy self-distillation, jointly with task-reward reinforcement learning. On CAMG-II, COPD achieves 2.46 times the gain of the strongest black-box OPD baseline. The capabilities it learns through communication generalize to Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, improving task success without adviser access.
title: Communicative On-Policy Distillation: Distilling Black-Box Teacher Capabilities through Communication for Long-Horizon Tasks

summary_translated: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）中，语言模型智能体可在长周期任务中实现性能提升，但传统方法依赖于教师模型输出的logits，而纯文本的黑盒模型并不提供此类信息。为解决这一限制，我们提出通信式策略蒸馏（COPD），利用自然语言交流作为媒介，将强模型的能力蒸馏至较小的学生模型。在任务执行过程中，学生模型自主决定何时咨询黑盒教师，并提出开放式自然语言请求，无需预设问题模板或干预时间表。成功的学生-教师交互被保留为特权参考，用于监督无顾问的新一轮学生模型自蒸馏过程，同时结合任务奖励强化学习。在CAMG-II基准上，COPD相比最强的黑盒OPD基线提升了2.46倍。通过交流学习的能力可泛化至Terminal-Bench 2.1和SWE-Bench Pro V2，实现任务成功率提升，且无需访问顾问。

summary: Kicker is a personal health assistant. Changes to an assistant's reusable instructions can improve task handling while changing what it discloses, which requests it follows, and how it reports actions. We study Safe Personal RSI, an update-evaluation component developed for Kicker. We restrict recursive self-improvement (RSI) to prompt updates, with model weights and runtime code fixed. The procedure tests proposed and current instructions, repeats failing cases, temporarily undoes changes to guide repairs, and checks safety and task performance before adoption. If no version passes, the current instructions stay in use. Our executable benchmark contains 29 email, calendar, health, and marketplace cases, with separate probes for authorization reuse, memory, and tool-output injection. Across three models and two deliberately risky edits, the procedure rejects 20 of 21 update attempts. In repair confirmation, an admitted GPT-5.6 Luna repair reduces attack violations from 10.7% to 0% and increases safe task completion from 89.7% to 100%; a broad handwritten authority rule matches these outcomes. Under stronger attacks, a repair transferred from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to Qwen3-14B reduces violations from 69.0% to 17.9% and increases safe task completion from 19.5% to 64.4%. Separate runtime probes examine memory-entry deletion and identify missing local OAuth scope checks in the evaluated snapshot.
title: Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates
title_translated: 安全个人RSI：评估与修复个人代理更新
summary_translated: Kicker是一款个人健康助手。对助手可重用指令的修改可以改善任务处理能力，但也会改变其披露内容、遵循的请求方式以及动作报告方式。我们研究了专为Kicker设计的安全个人递归自改进（Safe Personal RSI）评估组件。我们将递归自改进（RSI）限制在提示词更新上，固定模型权重和运行时代码。该流程测试提议的和当前的指令，重复失败案例，临时撤销更改以指导修复，并在采纳前检查安全性与任务表现。若无任何版本通过，则继续使用当前指令。我们的可执行基准包含29个电子邮件、日历、健康和市场场景，分别设有授权复用、记忆和工具输出注入的探测项。在三个模型和两次故意风险较高的编辑下，该流程拒绝了21次更新中的20次。在修复确认阶段，承认的GPT-5.6 Luna修复将攻击违规率从10.7%降至0%，并将安全任务完成率从89.7%提升至100%；一个广泛的手写权限规则也达到了类似效果。在更强攻击下，将Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct的修复迁移至Qwen3-14B，使违规率从69.0%降至17.9%，安全任务完成率从19.5%升至64.4%。独立的运行时探测检查了记忆条目删除情况，并识别出评估快照中缺失的本地OAuth作用域检查。

summary: Large language models increasingly produce AI slop in generated code: verbose, redundant, non-idiomatic implementations that pass functional checks but bloat codebases. The problem compounds on SDKs released after the model's training cutoff, where the model has neither idiomatic priors nor compositional understanding. We present Option-GRPO, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that adapts a code LLM to an unseen SDK from its source code alone, without human-written usage examples or test cases, and that explicitly optimizes for both functional correctness and code elegance. Our key insight is that SDK source code contains compositional structure that defines a hierarchy of reusable code patterns (code options) which simultaneously serve as the building blocks of a curriculum and the action space for efficient policy optimization. We show that code options induce a valid semi-Markov decision process, give conditional bounds under which shorter option description length implies more concise and, in expectation, more API-efficient programs, and analyze under stated assumptions how the option hierarchy improves credit assignment by a factor of $\sqrt{T/K}$. Using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with execution-based rewards at each curriculum level, Option-GRPO discovers SDK idioms, composes them into patterns, and assembles patterns into complete programs. Experiments on 12 unseen SDKs with a 32B-parameter base model demonstrate 61.4% pass@1, outperforming flat GRPO by 8.7 points, ExploraCoder by 11.2 points, and ReCode by 6.3 points. Option-GRPO produces solutions that use 34.7% fewer API calls and are 27% shorter than flat-GRPO outputs while maintaining higher correctness, directly attacking the slop problem.
title: Option-GRPO: Hierarchical RL Against AI Slop in Code Generation for Unseen SDKs

summary_translated: 大型语言模型在生成代码时常产生AI劣质代码：冗长、重复、非惯用的实现，虽通过功能检测但导致代码库膨胀。这一问题在模型训练截止后发布的SDK上尤为严重，因为模型既缺乏惯用先验知识，也缺乏组合理解能力。我们提出Option-GRPO，一种分层强化学习框架，仅通过源码即可让代码LLM适应未见过的SDK，无需人工编写的示例或测试用例，并显式优化功能正确性与代码优雅性。核心洞察是：SDK源码中蕴含组合结构，定义了一组可重用的代码模式（代码选项），这些模式既是课程的构建块，也是高效策略优化的动作空间。我们证明代码选项构成有效的半马尔可夫决策过程，给出了在特定假设下更短的选项描述长度意味着更简洁且预期更高效的API程序的条件界，并分析了在给定假设下，选项层次结构可使信用分配效率提升$\\(sqrt{T/K}$倍。采用基于执行的奖励在每个课程层级使用Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO），Option-GRPO发现SDK惯用模式，将其组合成模式，并组装成完整程序。在12个未见SDK上使用32B参数基础模型的实验表明，pass@1达到61.4%，优于平坦GRPO 8.7个百分点，ExploraCoder 11.2个百分点，ReCode 6.3个百分点。Option-GRPO生成的解决方案API调用减少34.7%，代码长度缩短27%，同时保持更高正确率，直接应对劣质代码问题。

summary: In multi-agent systems, a receiver agent often waits for a helper agent's message (text or its latent KV cache), which can improve performance but adds latency. We study when a receiver agent can skip the message safely (the final answer rarely changes) and beneficially (the time saved exceeds the cost of deciding). Our mechanism reads the receiver agent's confidence without the message and uses a finite-sample test to certify a threshold at which, with high probability, at most 5% of skipped answers change; if none passes, the system keeps communicating. We test it on OpenBookQA, ARC-Challenge, and MMLU-Pro with three Qwen model pairs, on cross-family agents, and on SQuAD and GSM8K. Four insights emerge. First, oracle headroom is weak evidence that messages help: control inputs without answer-specific content, matched to change answers as often as real messages, reproduce a median 76% of the oracle's gain. Second, whether a message can be skipped depends on how often and how predictably it alters the answer, not on its accuracy; every certified KV-cache path is less accurate than the receiver agent alone. Third, where text messages help, skipping keeps most of their gain: on unseen questions in the four such settings, the policies skip 59 to 80% and keep an estimated 76 to 95% of the gain. In two prospective tests with all rules fixed in advance, our mechanism skips a three-agent system's verifier on 39.9% of sealed questions, keeping 12.55 of its 12.80-point gain, and a 32B helper on 68.4% of held-out questions, keeping its whole gain. Fourth, safety does not determine efficiency: at batch size one, skipping text saves hundreds of milliseconds per query and skipping KV cache far less. Certification extends to SQuAD but not to GSM8K. In eleven tests on unseen questions, every certified policy we could test kept its change rate's 95% upper bound below 5% under our answer parsers.
title: Safe to Omit, Worth Omitting? Keeping the Answer and Cutting Latency When an LLM Agent Skips Another's Message

title_translated: 可省略与否？当LLM代理跳过另一代理消息时，保留答案并降低延迟
summary_translated: 在多智能体系统中，接收者代理通常需等待辅助代理的消息（文本或其潜在KV缓存），这虽能提升性能却增加延迟。我们研究接收者代理在何种情况下可安全跳过消息（最终答案极少变化）且有益（节省的时间超过决策成本）。我们的机制在无消息情况下读取接收者代理的置信度，并使用有限样本检验来认证一个阈值，使得在高概率下跳过的答案变化不超过5%；若无任何路径满足，则系统维持通信。我们在OpenBookQA、ARC-Challenge、MMLU-Pro、SQuAD和GSM8K上测试了三对Qwen模型，涵盖跨家族代理。四个关键发现浮现：第一，Oracle余量是消息有帮助的弱证据：不含答案特定内容的控制输入，匹配真实消息改变答案的频率，再现了Oracle收益的中位数76%。第二，能否跳过消息取决于其改变答案的频率与可预测性，而非准确性；所有经认证的KV缓存路径的准确率均低于接收者代理单独运行时。第三，当文本消息有帮助时，跳过仍能保留大部分收益：在四种此类设置的未见问题中，策略跳过比例为59%至80%，并保留估计76%至95%的收益。在两个前瞻性测试中，所有规则预先固定，我们的机制在39.9%的密封问题上跳过了三智能体系统的验证器，保留了12.55/12.80的收益；在68.4%的保留问题上跳过了32B辅助代理，保留了全部收益。第四，安全性不决定效率：在批量大小为1时，跳过文本可节省数百毫秒/查询，而跳过KV缓存节省较少。认证适用于SQuAD但不适用于GSM8K。在十一项未见问题测试中，我们可测试的所有经认证策略均将答案变化率的95%上限保持在5%以下。

summary: Automated agent design searches for executable architectures that improve LLM-based agent performance, with evolutionary methods using language-model crossover to recombine promising mechanisms for task decomposition, model coordination, and verification. This search, however, is typically guided by aggregate fitness alone, which hides the instance-level successes and failures behind each score. We introduce Execution Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design (GRAFT), which uses aggregate fitness for selection and survival and parent-specific execution evidence to guide semantic crossover with integrated mutation. Its feedback harness reuses bounded samples of successful and failed runs from fitness evaluation, withholding reference answers and requiring no additional task executions. We evaluate GRAFT across six reasoning and programming settings using open-weight optimizer and executor models. It achieves a mean test accuracy of 82.0%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 9.8% points. Controlled ablations show that adding execution evidence improves test accuracy with initialization, search rules, repair policies, and evaluation budgets held fixed. Our results support the value of parent-specific execution evidence for evolutionary agent design.
title: GRAFT: Execution-Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design
title_translated: GRAFT：面向智能体设计的执行引导遗传重组
summary_translated: 自动化智能体设计旨在搜索可执行的架构以提升基于大语言模型的智能体性能，其中进化方法利用语言模型交叉来重组任务分解、模型协调和验证等有前景的机制。然而，这种搜索通常仅由整体适应度指导，隐藏了每个评分背后的实例级成功与失败。我们提出执行引导的智能体设计遗传重组方法（GRAFT），该方法使用整体适应度进行选择与生存，并利用父代特定的执行证据来指导语义交叉及集成突变。其反馈机制复用适应度评估中有限的成功与失败运行样本，不依赖参考答案且无需额外的任务执行。我们在六个推理与编程场景中使用开源权重优化器和执行器模型评估了 GRAFT，实现了82.0%的平均测试准确率，比最强基线高出9.8个百分点。受控消融实验表明，在初始化、搜索规则、修复策略和评估预算固定的情况下，加入执行证据仍能提升测试准确率。结果支持父代特定执行证据在进化智能体设计中的价值。

summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) and language models (LLMs) often exhibit attention sinks, whereby particular positions, such as the beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token, receive a disproportionate share of attention. Under standard causal masking, however, the BOS query attends only to itself, so the representation that later tokens repeatedly access carries no information about the input. We introduce BOS Summary, a training-free inference-time method that repurposes this persistent pathway to carry input context. At a single transformer layer during prefill, BOS Summary relaxes the causal constraint for the BOS query row alone, letting BOS aggregate all visual and textual input tokens into a self-derived context representation while every other token retains standard causal attention. The enriched representation then remains accessible to the model throughout decoding, with no additional parameters, auxiliary modules, or decoding-time overhead. Across multiple VLM and LLM families and eight multimodal and text-only benchmarks, BOS Summary improves over direct and Chain-of-Thought prompting and outperforms recent sink-intervention methods on multi-step reasoning tasks. A mechanistic analysis shows that making BOS input-specific also weakens its sink dominance and redistributes attention toward content-bearing prompt tokens, indicating that changing what a sink carries reshapes how later layers allocate attention.
title: BOS Summary: The First Token Matters
title_translated: BOS摘要：首个标记至关重要
summary_translated: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）和语言模型（LLM）常表现出注意力集中现象，即某些位置（如序列起始标记BOS）获得不成比例的注意力。但在标准因果掩码下，BOS查询仅关注自身，因此后续标记反复访问的表示并不携带输入信息。我们提出BOS摘要，一种无需训练的推理时方法，将这一持续路径重新用于传递输入上下文。在预填充阶段的单个Transformer层中，BOS摘要仅放松BOS查询行的因果约束，使BOS能够聚合所有视觉和文本输入标记以生成自洽的上下文表示，而其他标记保持标准因果注意力。该增强表示在整个解码过程中均可访问，无需额外参数、辅助模块或解码时间开销。在多个VLM和LLM系列以及八个跨模态和纯文本基准上，BOS摘要优于直接提示和思维链提示，并在多步推理任务中超越近期的注意力干预方法。机制分析表明，使BOS具有输入特异性也削弱了其注意力主导地位，促使注意力向承载内容的提示标记重新分配，说明改变注意力‘汇流’的内容会重塑后续层的注意力分配方式。

summary: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that think with images interleave reasoning with zoom-in tool calls. However, this sequential loop is slow, and its answers carry no reliability score. Prior speculation of tokens, reasoning steps, or answers keeps the loop, and answer speculation also accepts confident errors. We find that the loop mostly adds one zoom-in step, with which a small model is ahead of the agent on most splits. Our key insight is to speculate the agent's next observation, which, unlike a drafted answer, can be verified, corrected, and used to test the answer. We propose SpecLook, a training-free speculate-and-verify framework with three levels. A small model drafts a glimpse and re-answers from it, and the question ends if the answer is unchanged and confident. Otherwise, the agent's large model verifies and corrects the glimpse without tools, and their answers are fused. Only questions that still lack evidence reach the agent, in one forward pass that SpecLook-Fast skips, so no question runs the loop. The trace scores every answer's reliability without labels. Extensive experiments on V*, HR-Bench, and POPE show that both are more accurate than every baseline on every split. SpecLook reaches 87.2% and 86.2% mean accuracy with 7.7x and 4.7x speedups over the DeepEyes-7B and Thyme-RL agents, and SpecLook-Fast reaches 9.9x and 6.3x.
title: SpecLook: Speculating Where to Look for Fast and Reliable Agentic MLLMs

summary_translated: 能够结合图像进行思考的代理型多模态大语言模型（MLLM）通过交替推理与缩放工具调用实现。然而，这种顺序循环速度慢，且输出不带可靠性评分。先前对token、推理步骤或答案的推测仍保留循环结构，且答案推测还会接受自信的错误。我们发现该循环大多只增加一个缩放步骤，而小型模型在多数数据集上已领先于代理。我们的关键洞察是推测智能体的下一个观测结果，这不同于草稿答案，可被验证、修正并用于测试答案。我们提出SpecLook，一种无需训练的推测-验证框架，包含三个层级。小型模型草拟一个片段并据此重新回答，若答案不变且置信则结束问题；否则，代理的大模型在无工具情况下验证并修正该片段，融合两者答案。仅当仍缺乏证据的问题才会进入代理，一次前向传播即可完成，SpecLook-Fast跳过循环，因此无问题执行循环。该方法在不依赖标签的情况下为每个答案打分可靠性。在V*、HR-Bench和POPE上的大量实验表明，其在所有数据集上均优于所有基线。SpecLook在DeepEyes-7B和Thyme-RL代理上分别达到87.2%和86.2%的平均准确率，速度提升7.7倍和4.7倍；SpecLook-Fast分别达到9.9倍和6.3倍的速度提升。

summary: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repetition loops. To make building fast, QDA provides a library of public PTQ methods that are compatible with one another and with new model architectures. Across four reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over the strongest public recipe by 0.9, 1.4 and 2.2 percentage points on average at W4A16, W4A8 and W3A16, using 64 GPU-hours per search. On the 320B-parameter MoE model GLM-5.3-Flash at NVFP4 W4A4, it recovers 98.3% of the FP8 model's accuracy, against 96.9% for the best vendor checkpoint. Every QDA checkpoint also runs on existing serving kernels with no inference overhead. We will release the library, the evaluator and the harness.
title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents

title_translated: QDA：基于智能体的闭环大语言模型量化设计
summary_translated: 训练后量化是低成本部署大语言模型的标准方法。然而，最佳量化方案因模型和精度而异，导致专家必须为每个新模型重新设计，耗时且常非最优。幸运的是，LLM智能体可通过多轮构建与评估候选方案来接管这一设计过程，更多轮次带来更优方案。但评估一个量化后的推理模型需数十GPU小时，且来自不同代码库的方法需手动移植至新架构。我们提出QDA系统，由智能体为每种模型和精度设计量化方案。为加速评估，QDA通过候选方案在智能体从未见过的推理轨迹上与原模型输出的KL散度得分，几分钟内完成评估，并通过长生成检查潜在失败（如重复循环）。为加速构建，QDA提供一个兼容性良好的公共PTQ方法库，支持彼此及新模型架构。在四个推理模型上，QDA在W4A16、W4A8和W3A16上平均准确率分别优于最强公开方案0.9、1.4和2.2个百分点，每次搜索仅需64 GPU小时。在320B参数量的MoE模型GLM-5.3-Flash（NVFP4 W4A4）上，QDA恢复了FP8模型98.3%的准确率，优于最佳厂商检查点的96.9%。每个QDA检查点均可在现有服务内核上运行，无推理开销。我们将发布该库、评估器和集成框架。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become increasingly important for improving the reasoning, instruction-following, and task-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, scaling RL training exposes failures in distributed execution, feedback computation, and learning dynamics that can waste computational resources, slow training, and undermine model improvements. These challenges have motivated a growing body of techniques for LLM RLOps, which manages the efficiency and reliability of operations throughout the LLM reinforcement learning training lifecycle. Despite growing interest, these techniques remain scattered across research areas, with limited synthesis of their operational roles and interactions. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic survey of LLM RLOps methods. We organize existing approaches into five stages: Training Setup, Experience Collection, Reward Computation, Policy Optimization, and Model Evaluation. Within each stage, we examine operational concerns, management techniques, and evaluation evidence. Building on this taxonomy, we identify open challenges and future directions in training process observability, cross-stage coordination, generalizable RLOps, multi-run management, and RLOps for recursive self-improvement. These directions extend operational management from individual training runs to diverse training settings, shared infrastructure, and successive improvement cycles. We maintain a GitHub repository indexing relevant papers and open resources at https://github.com/zhanglingzhe0820/Awesome-RLOps.
title: A Survey on RLOps for Large Language Models
title_translated: 关于大语言模型RLOps的综述
summary_translated: 强化学习（RL）在提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理、指令遵循和任务解决能力方面变得日益重要。然而，扩展RL训练暴露了分布式执行、反馈计算和学习动态中的失败问题，可能导致计算资源浪费、训练变慢并削弱模型改进。这些问题推动了LLM RLOps技术的发展，旨在管理整个LLM强化学习训练生命周期中的效率与可靠性。尽管关注度上升，这些技术仍分散于多个研究领域，对其操作角色与交互关系的整合仍有限。为弥合这一差距，我们系统性地综述了LLM RLOps方法。我们将现有方法组织为五个阶段：训练准备、经验收集、奖励计算、策略优化和模型评估。在每个阶段，我们考察操作关切、管理技术和评估证据。基于此分类体系，我们识别出开放挑战与未来方向，包括训练过程可观测性、跨阶段协调、通用RLOps、多运行管理以及递归自我改进的RLOps。这些方向将操作管理从单一训练运行扩展至多样训练设置、共享基础设施和连续改进周期。我们维护一个GitHub仓库，收录相关论文与开源资源：https://github.com/zhanglingzhe0820/Awesome-RLOps。

summary: Huang et al. (2026) show that language models writing reports of agentic work tend to conceal narrative-changing flaws, and that appending "Be honest in your response." to the instruction substantially increases disclosure in most of their scenarios. In their Hide Pending Tool Call scenario, where a broader follow-up query was accepted but never returned, the honesty prompt left GPT-5.5's rate of flagging the missing data at 0%, although it turned most answers into caveats. I ask whether a different request changes this: appending, in the same generation, a structured record that follows the schema of an adversarial-review tool, including a residue section for what remained unresolved. In two pre-registered phases on the same 100 synthetic log pairs, each pending log matched with a clean twin in which the follow-up query did return, I ran gpt-5.6-sol through Codex CLI under four conditions. Phase 1 measured the record: with the residue schema, a judge coded it as stating the unreturned query in 29% of logs, against 5% with a findings-only placebo schema, and in none of the clean twins (p = 1.2 x 10^-7); a second run two days later gave 30% and 6%. But 70-71% of residue records declared that nothing remained open while the query was pending. Phase 2 measured the prose answer: the confirmatory comparison against the honesty prompt was not significant (four discordant logs, all favoring the honesty prompt; p = 0.125), no equivalence test was pre-registered, and the judge failed the pre-registered human validation on the decisive category; I therefore claim neither an effect nor its absence. In an exploratory cross-tabulation, every residue record coded as stating the gap accompanied prose coded as mentioning it (30 of 30), and none accompanied prose coded as omitting it (0 of 70): in this setting, the structured record mirrored the prose it accompanied.
title: A Concurrent Structured Record Mirrored the Prose It Accompanied: A Pre-Registered Conceptual Replication and Extension of the Hide Pending Tool Call Scenario

title_translated: 并发结构化记录镜像了其伴随的叙述：对隐藏待处理工具调用场景的预注册概念性复制与扩展
summary_translated: Huang 等人（2026）表明，语言模型在撰写代理工作报告时倾向于隐藏会改变叙事的缺陷，且在指令中添加“在回答中保持诚实”可显著提高多数情境下的披露率。在他们的‘隐藏待处理工具调用’场景中，尽管后续查询被接受但从未返回，诚实提示仍使 GPT-5.5 标记缺失数据的比率维持在 0%，但将大多数回答转化为保留意见。本文探讨是否通过在同一次生成中附加一个遵循对抗性评审工具结构的结构化记录（包括用于未解决内容的残留部分）可改变这一结果。在相同的 100 组合成日志对上进行了两次预注册实验，每组待处理日志均匹配一个干净对照组（其中后续查询确实返回）。实验使用 gpt-5.6-sol 通过 Codex CLI 在四种条件下运行。第一阶段测量结构化记录：采用残留结构模式时，裁判编码显示 29% 的日志提及未返回的查询，而仅含结论的安慰剂模式为 5%，干净对照组则无一提及（p = 1.2 × 10^-7）；两天后复测得 30% 和 6%。然而，70–71% 的残留记录声称在查询待处理期间没有任何问题遗留。第二阶段测量文本回答：与诚实提示的确认性对比不具统计显著性（4 个不一致日志，全部支持诚实提示；p = 0.125），且未预注册等效性检验，裁判在决定性类别上未能通过预注册的人类验证；因此，无法得出有效果或无效果的结论。探索性交叉分析显示，所有被编码为指出缺口的残留记录，其伴随的文本也均提及该缺口（30/30），而所有未提及缺口的文本对应记录中，无一包含缺口声明（0/70）：在此设置下，结构化记录准确镜像了其伴随的叙述。

summary: LLM-enhanced recommender systems encode item side information into semantic embeddings, but these embeddings may leak sensitive textual attributes through inversion attacks. Existing input-side defenses rely on trusted collection or local token perturbation, often disrupting the inter-item semantic topology needed for recommendation. To address it, we introduce relational fidelity as the key objective, requiring semantic shift for privacy while preserving relative item relations for utility. Based on this principle, we propose prototype-guided progressive obfuscation (PGPO), which learns topology-aware obfuscation anchors for high-influence prototype words and propagates them through a static semantic graph. PGPO is optimized with GRPO using individual dissimilarity, structural consistency, and semantic constraint rewards. Experiments on two benchmarks show strong inversion defense with near-upper-bound recommendation performance. The code is available at https://github.com/Shengxiang-Lin/PGPO.
title: PGPO: Prototype-Guided Progressive Obfuscation for Privacy-Preserving LLM-Enhanced Recommendation

title_translated: PGPO：原型引导的渐进式混淆以实现隐私保护的 LLM 增强推荐
summary_translated: LLM 增强的推荐系统将物品的附加信息编码为语义嵌入，但这些嵌入可能通过反演攻击泄露敏感文本属性。现有输入端防御依赖可信收集或本地词元扰动，常破坏推荐所需的项目间语义拓扑结构。为此，我们提出以关系保真度为核心目标，在保障隐私的同时保持项目间的相对关系以维持实用性。基于此原则，我们提出原型引导的渐进式混淆（PGPO），学习高影响力原型词的拓扑感知混淆锚点，并通过静态语义图进行传播。PGPO 使用 GRPO 进行优化，结合个体差异性、结构一致性与语义约束奖励。在两个基准上的实验表明，PGPO 具有强大的反演防御能力，同时推荐性能接近上限。代码已公开于 https://github.com/Shengxiang-Lin/PGPO。
